entries.title: Psalms 111:1
segments: ¶Hallelujah! I will celebrate Jehovah with [my] whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the assembly.

entries.title: Psalms 111:2
segments: Great are the works of Jehovah; sought out of all that delight in them.

entries.title: Psalms 111:3
segments: His work is majesty and splendour, and his righteousness abideth for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 111:4
segments: He hath made his wonders to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.

entries.title: Psalms 111:5
segments: He hath given meat unto them that fear him; he is ever mindful of his covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 111:6
segments: ¶He hath shewn his people the power of his works, to give them the heritage of the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 111:7
segments: The works of his hands are truth and judgment; all his precepts are faithful:

entries.title: Psalms 111:8
segments: Maintained for ever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 111:9
segments: He sent deliverance unto his people; he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and terrible is his name.

entries.title: Psalms 111:10
segments: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; a good understanding have all they that do [his precepts]: his praise abideth for ever.
